_comment: Embarque → Aduana for La selva (2026-11-28), read by Mission Control (the growth view and a
presented session's class votes). Unlike El Viaje and El Mundial, La selva does NOT load
/js/espanol-checks.js: the story draws its own picture-tap boarding pass (Form A at Embarque,
Form B at Aduana, three items each, as built in prototype v1.3) and saves the same `checks`
record on the student's module_progress/la-selva: { v, form: 'A', emb: [0|1 x3], adu: [0|1 x3],
embDone, aduDone }. Slot i is item i of both forms. Each item is spoken (Escucha) and answered
with a picture; `q` is the Spanish the student hears, `o` describes the pictures, the right one
is index 0 (`a`). The page shuffles the order it shows. No postcard and no rubric: grades 4–8,
and nothing is typed anywhere in this story.
title: La selva
focus: Hearing singular vs. plural, color words that agree, and numbers

slots.skill: One or more: hears the plural (-s, las/los) with no number
slots.mis: Hears the noun but not that it is plural

slots.skill: Color + plural: the color word agrees (-es, -s)
slots.mis: Matches the animal but not its color or number
Picks a number that sounds alike (tres / trece)

A.why: Los and the -s on pizotes both say more than one.
Amarillas is yellow, and its -s agrees with flores: more than one.
Seis is 6. Siete is 7, diez is 10.

B.why: Las and the -s on iguanas both say more than one.
Verdes is green, and its -es agrees with loros: more than one.
Dos is 2. Diez is 10, doce is 12.
